lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately ten vertical columns of circular high-luminance blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit a semi-regular spatial arrangement, with larger diameter blobs positioned more ventrally along the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the columns of circular blobs, forming a grid-like intersection pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper surfaces to dark shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a distribution of approximately 18 small, high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated in the lower and middle sections of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A V-shaped indentation or notch is visible on the posterior margin (trailing edge) of the first dorsal fin near its apex.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a dense pattern of small, high-intensity spots that decrease in size towards the distal edge.
